payload.title: Bug: mergeRunnerItemLocked's fgos-write-rejected restore only trusts main's HEAD for merge=union…
payload.description: Bug: mergeRunnerItemLocked's fgos-write-rejected restore only trusts main's HEAD for merge=union .fgos/ paths, so a stale worker branch (its .fgos/ snapshot frozen at fork, never intentionally edited) permanently blocks sync-root/approve on any non-union .fgos/ path that main has since grown (config.json restructured, legacy events.jsonl content, or a since-removed backup file) -- even though the branch's own committed content is provably byte-identical to some ancestor no different from its branchHeadAtTake (zero real branch-authored edit). Confirmed live merging fgw/tsk-25b (branch frozen 13 days, .fgos/config.json/events.jsonl untouched since fork): sync-root reports blocked/fgos-write-rejected with paths [.fgos/config.json, .fgos/events.jsonl, .fgos/events.jsonl.backup-tsk-1lv-4-dedup-fix-20260817], and this cannot be fixed via any commit on the worker branch (ADR0020's pre-commit hook -- stagedFgosChangesOnWorkerBranch and stagedFgosDeletions -- refuses ANY staged .fgos/ change or deletion on a worker branch, in either direction, verified by direct attempt) nor by deleting the stale path from main (stagedFgosDeletions blocks .fgos/ deletions unconditionally, on any branch, verified by direct attempt). Extended .gitattributes merge=union coverage to two more append-only logs (changelog-nag-history.jsonl, entropy-history.jsonl) as a partial, safe fix, but config.json (structured, not union-safe) and the legacy events.jsonl baseline (deliberately retired from union per tsk-4gi, still load-bearing per src/state/replay.mjs) need a real logic change, not an attribute. Proposed direction: extend mergeRunnerItemLocked's write-rejected restore step (src/runner/merge.mjs, the isMergeUnionPath-gated git checkout HEAD -- <path> loop) with a second, narrower trust criterion alongside isMergeUnionPath -- e.g. restore-to-main's-HEAD is also safe when the branch's own current blob for that .fgos/ path is git-identical to the blob at the item's own recorded branchHeadAtTake (proves zero intentional branch-side edit, not just 'differs from main today') -- keeping the existing union-path restore untouched. This never needs a worker-branch commit (the restore happens on repoRoot's own staged index during the merge attempt, before any commit lands anywhere), so ADR0020's worker-branch guards don't apply to this fix at all.
